name: Archiveye
description: Archiveye consente agli utenti autenticati di individuare le proprie raccolte attive nella base di conoscenza, effettuare ricerche nei documenti indicizzati tramite recupero semantico o full-text, esaminare i metadati dei documenti, interrogare set di dati tabulari strutturati con SQL in sola lettura e caricare il testo completo dei documenti quando le anteprime di ricerca non sono sufficienti. La ricerca semantica genera gli embedding delle query tramite il servizio di embedding gestito internamente da Archiveye prima di recuperare i segmenti corrispondenti dalle raccolte private dell'utente.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Archiveye to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Archiveye to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.archiveye.ai/user/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Archiveye MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Archiveye provides these MCP tools: execute_tabular_query, get_document, get_document_content, get_tabular_schema, list_collections, search_fulltext, and search_semantic.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Archiveye?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Archiveye in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Archiveye requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Archiveye is developed by Pura digital S.r.l.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
